description:
Intent i033 (tasklet-napi-softirq-lock, snapshot s04) complete. Two findings written to the final artifact.

Finding 1 (medium): drivers/net/ethernet/freescale/fs_enet/fs_enet-main.c:768-784 — process-context fs_enet_close (.ndo_stop) takes fep->tx_lock with plain spin_lock (line 780) inside spin_lock_irqsave(&fep->lock, flags) (line 779), which disables IRQs but not bottom halves. The same lock is taken with plain spin_lock at line 229 inside fs_enet_tx_napi (NAPI poll registered by netif_napi_add at line 1035), which runs in NET_RX softirq context on the same CPU; the poll is scheduled from the shared hardirq fs_enet_interrupt via napi_schedule_prep/__napi_schedule (lines 376/384, request_irq ... IRQF_SHARED at line 745). In the close path, netif_stop_queue (771) only discourages xmit and napi_disable (775-776) waits out only in-flight polls, while free_irq happens only at line 788 — after the lock section — so the still-registered IRQ can schedule a new poll that spins forever against the close-path holder (self-deadlock / soft-lockup). The file contains zero spin_lock_bh, so no site disables BH for this lock; the untrusted source is the ioctl/NAPI scheduling path and the unsafe use is the non-BH-safe lock ordering. Counterevidence checked: napi_disable narrows the window; the hardirq-context interrupt handler itself takes fep->lock via spin_lock_irqsave, so the irqsave on the outer lock mitigates IRQ re-entry but not softirq re-entry.

Finding 2 (low): drivers/net/ethernet/altera/altera_tse_main.c:1214-1241 — process-context tse_shutdown (.ndo_stop) takes priv->tx_lock with plain spin_lock at line 1239, while the same lock is taken plainly at line 459 in tse_tx_complete, called from NAPI poll tse_poll (line 508; netif_napi_add line 1515), scheduled from hardirq altera_isr (napi_schedule_prep line 548, __napi_schedule line 553; request_irq lines 1160/1169). The xmit path correctly uses spin_lock_bh(&priv->tx_lock) at line 578, proving the driver knows the lock requires BH disable, making the plain NAPI/shutdown sites a mixed-discipline defect. Confidence is low because the shutdown path disables tx/rx DMA IRQs (1228-1232), free_irqs (1234-1235) and napi_disable (1225) before the plain acquisition, which narrows the softirq window to the gap between ISR napi_schedule and napi_disable completion.

Candidate classifications: fs_enet-main.c:229 and :780 and altera_tse_main.c:459 and :1239 reported; fs_enet-main.c:535 (xmit-path lock use) safe-for-this-branch as it belongs to the xmit-softirq-lock sibling branch; mwl8k.c:6106 tasklet pair verified safe for this branch because every tx_lock site uses spin_lock_bh (1563/1576/1582/2049/4629) and the plain stream_lock sites are the xmit-branch finding (f010), excluded here.

Negative/bounded evidence: the whole-tree tasklet/NAPI enumeration was halted by the finalize directive; iwlwifi pcie/rx.c, mt76 q->lock, ath9k/ath5k, hostap, qtnfmac and cw1200 tasklet/NAPI lock pairings in s04 were not exhaustively enumerated and are listed as limitations. All conclusions are static source hypotheses with no build, lockdep run or reproducer; searches were restricted to snapshot s04 only.
